node.label: Japan 10-year yield
node.up: Japanese money can finally earn something at home instead of abroad
node.what: What Japan pays to borrow for ten years. It was pinned near zero for a generation, which pushed Japanese institutions — among the world's largest bond buyers — into foreign debt. Every basis point it rises is a reason for that money to come home.
